record_notes.DCP-LETT-1111: August 19, supplied 1847. Missing De la Beche note answered after learning Studer plans. record_notes.DCP-LETT-1169: April 7, supplied 1848. Incomplete damaged defence of coral theory follows De la Beche suggestion and published address, not a source-complete personal incoming letter. Requested charts not supplied by reduced published image; no new complete prompt.

record_notes.DCP-LETT-1203: Accepted full primary reading reused with matched source and provenance hashes. October 13 Darjeeling: Hooker reports Falconer illness, institutional quarrel and pension claims as his own assessments or hearsay, not objective resolutions. Rain-bound collecting, elevation labels, Hodgson support, and still uncertain Sikkim access frame prospective snow/Terai survey; Nepal permission is received while Sikkim passage remains blocked. P6–11 describe geology, forest soils and Muller analyses, challenge detrital coal, hypothesize heat dissipation and glaciers, explicitly disclaiming adequate observation. Future travel and later annexation in editorial notes are not contemporary outcomes. P12 promises pamphlet dispatch through his father and explicitly attributes P13–22 answers to Hodgson: seedlings/sterility, tea, goats, hybrid claims, fowl/dogs, deer, silk moths and an inherited scar anecdote. Preserve these as attributed historical reports, including uncertain parentage/outcomes, not modern zoological conclusions. P23–25 closes with health, family greetings and request to write Hodgson. The promised answer to 1174 is supported by 1193 and the exact domestic-breed categories; cannot answer 1202 written only seven days before in England. Separate undated CD markings include Coal Paper on cover.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1202: Accepted full primary reading reused with matched source and provenance hashes. October 6 with supplied 1848 year: answers tiny note, Hooker freedom from heart pains, Hodgson pamphlets/Pallas, response to supplemental males and Falconer illness, a distinctive cluster matching 1193. Other expedition news came through Sir William and Frances Henslow; missing or unidentified letters remain separate inputs. Gratitude for pamphlets does not specify physical delivery or reading. Ross Voyage is explicitly finished and botanical summaries abstracted; September 17 completion is separately documented in footnote, not the date of this letter. Darwin does not yet identify the Falkland cattle-hunt author; later 1220 revelation cannot be imported. P4 describes new dissections, provisional more curious case withheld, homologies and proposed nomenclature reform; it does not describe the withheld case or prove successful reform. Reply link is supported, while Ross reading and other news extend beyond the tiny note.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1239: Accepted full primary reading reused with matched source and provenance hashes. April 9 Malvern. Two Hooker letters arrived morning after posting previous letter; Darwin guesses March 23 but editor corrects previous letter to March 28. Keep relative receipt event and conditional March 29 inference separate; no independent posting timestamp. Geological letter exchanged with Lyell for a further unlocated Nepal account. P2 refuses Athenaeum extracts without a finished concise account; the two geological letters discussed there may be1219 plus the Lyell-directed account, not the gossip companion. P3 asks distinctive glacial/terrace evidence, distant boulder source, scores, height below current ice, stratification, hard river bed and red clay, while keeping lake interpretation uncertain. P5 answers request to preserve letters; P6 answers nomenclature warning and ornamental-poultry question, securely identifying1220 rather than only a generic gossip label. Health stopped naming campaign; support from several naturalists is not campaign success. P7 corrects own1236 statement: coal paper found that same evening among books from father parcel, now read, with earlier oral aquatic-coal discussion recalled. Physical receipt preceded awareness and reading. Raw MathML says half a dozen, not twelve. Whole answer has multiple identified and one unlocated incoming source; no duplication as independent whole-letter examples.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1237: Accepted full primary reading reused with matched source and provenance hashes. March 30, 1849. Explicitly writes from Malvern despite Down dateline; address is not physical location. No Covington letter for years, asks personal news and specimen collection, not direct reply to a current preserved input. Father death dated November 13, own water-cure improvement and two-month plan contemporary; six children and projected eighteen-month publication retained literally. Beagle/officer and family news attributed as knowledge/report. Sydney Mail source and de Beer later divergent transcripts must remain distinct; apparatus suggests de Beer normalized usual writing style, no authority to silently adopt revisions.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1238: Accepted full primary reading reused with matched source and provenance hashes. Sunday morning assigned June24,1849 from Cresy letter of22nd, final Malvern Sunday and June30 return. Missing June22 letter forwarded from Down, actual arrival not separately dated. Darwin explicitly states March10 arrival at Malvern, firmer than retrospective nearly-two-month estimates elsewhere. King good wishes based on testimonials/writings/secondhand reports; refuses canvassing because not personally acquainted, but conditionally offers to mention him to Owen. Returning documents avoids copies; texts unavailable. Return home beginning next month intended; actual June30 later. Possible Franklin-search canvassing purpose editorial conjecture, not established contents of missing appeal.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1319: Accepted full primary reading reused with matched source and provenance hashes. Two composition sections, April6 Government House and April7 Botanic Gardens, not mutually exclusive alternative dates. April6P1–6 responds to earlier full letters received about two months previously:1260 is identified by species-versus-barnacle preference and correction of Yangma dam to moraine. Hooker says theories interest but do not convert him, reports well-marked Sikkim willows/Rubi/Senecios/Gnaphalia despite equable climate and revises Himalayan drainage, snowline and glacier model. Falconer/Thomson and Humboldt views are attributed, current theory provisional. April7P8 recounts five-month parcel withholding, seven Frances letters released, reconciliation and good health; only later within this section explicitly acknowledges February letter received this morning and responds to incomplete cure and seven children, identifying1300. Do not let this April7 input condition April6 prose. Nepal permission attempt fails, Sylhet/Khassya/Manipur journey and Thomson joining prospective; later May1 departure is editorial. Footnote2 preserves an original Darwin abstract of this letter plus later marks: its April6 label dates the source letter, not Darwin taking notes that day in England.
